extraction.name: CommonCatalog
extraction.description: A dataset of roughly 70 million open-licensed Creative-Commons images paired with high-quality synthetic captions generated via a transfer-learning approach called telephoning.
extraction.creator: Aaron Gokaslan; Feder Cooper; Jasmine Collins; Landan Seguin; Austin Jacobson; Mihir Patel; Jonathan Frankle; Cory Stephenson; Volodymyr Kuleshov
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was constructed by excluding non-derivative licensed images from Creative Commons images, splitting the remainder into commercial and non-commercial subsets, and then generating synthetic captions for the images using the pre-trained BLIP-2 OPT2.5B model after center-cropping and resizing images to 512x512 for captioning.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Creative Commons images from YFCC100M, excluding non-derivative licensed images; the source images often lacked usable alt-text captions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Synthetic captions were generated for uncaptained Creative-Commons images using a pre-trained BLIP-2 image-to-text model; these synthetic image-caption pairs were then used as labels for training.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset has incompleteness and scarcity issues associated with Creative-Commons images, and the resulting models under-perform in some categories such as faces.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is limited by incompleteness and scarcity of CC images, some model performance gaps (e.g., faces), and the fact that YFCC100M images are about a decade old and less current than LAION-2B.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The work is positioned as enabling text-to-image training using only open-licensed data, addressing copyright concerns around training data.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is used for training text-to-image latent diffusion models, specifically CommonCanvas models and SD2-style training.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors plan future augmentation of CommonCatalog with Creative-Commons images from other sources; hosting of data and models is mentioned, but no explicit versioning or deprecation policy is provided.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Curated a dataset of open-licensed Creative-Commons images and generated synthetic captions for previously uncaptioned CC images using a pre-trained BLIP-2 model, forming image-caption pairs for training.

name.evidence: The above methods enable us to create CommonCanvas, a suite of latent diffusion model (LDM) architectures trained on our curated dataset of CC images and synthetic captions, which we denote CommonCatalog.

description.evidence: Curate CommonCatalog, a dataset of roughly 70 million open-licensed CC images, for which we use telephoning to generate accompanying high-quality synthetic captions (Section 4).

url.evidence: Release our CommonCatalog dataset of CC images and synthetic captions along with our trained CommonCanvas model at https://github.com/mosaicml/diffusion/blob/main/assets/common-canvas.md.
